featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience at this PAN
Card Center. The staff here is extremely helpful, polite, and professional. From the moment I entered, they guided me properly through the entire PAN card process and explained everything clearly in simple language, which made the process stress-free.

All the work was done quickly and efficiently. They checked my documents carefully, filled out the form correctly, and ensured there were no mistakes. featured_reviews.name: Joshita Hedau
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent stationery and printing shop with fast and reliable service. The staff is helpful, and the quality of printouts is very good. Prices are reasonable, and all basic to advanced stationery items are available. A perfect place for students and office work.

featured_reviews.name: Hansa S
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Xerox Centre is a very convenient and reliable place for all kinds of printing and documentation needs. From simple black-and-white photocopies to more detailed color prints, laminations, scanning, and binding, the centre offers a wide range of services that are especially helpful for students, professionals, and small businesses.

One of the biggest advantages of this Xerox Centre is its efficiency. Even during busy hours, the staff usually manage orders quickly and try their best to minimize waiting time. This is particularly useful when you’re in a rush to submit assignments, project reports, forms, or official documents. The machines are generally well-maintained, which results in clear prints and consistent quality.

The staff members are cooperative and helpful. They are willing to explain options such as paper quality, print size, color vs. black-and-white, and binding types, which is great for customers who are not very familiar with printing details. They handle documents carefully and make sure the final output matches what the customer asked for. If there is any mistake, they are usually open to correcting it.

Pricing at the Xerox Centre is reasonable and affordable, especially for students. Bulk printing and photocopying are often priced fairly, making it a good option for large projects or exam-related work. The transparency in pricing also helps, as there are usually no unexpected charges.

The location and accessibility of the Xerox Centre are another plus point. It is easy to find and well-situated for regular foot traffic. The shop layout is functional, and while it may not be very spacious, it is organized enough to handle multiple customers at once.

Overall, the Xerox Centre is a dependable place for everyday printing and copying needs. With good service quality, helpful staff, fair pricing, and quick turnaround time, it stands out as a practical and trustworthy option. A few improvements like more seating space or additional machines during peak hours could make the experience even better, but as it is, the Xerox Centre does a solid job and is highly recommended for regular use.

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Khade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I absolutely love this stationery shop and always look forward to visiting! The variety of products available is amazing — from high-quality notebooks, pens, and art supplies to cute stickers, planners, and unique finds you don’t see everywhere. Everything is neatly organized, making it easy to browse, and the store itself has such a calm and inspiring vibe that makes you want to spend more time there.

The quality of the items is excellent, especially considering the reasonable prices. Whether you’re a student, artist, journal lover, or just someone who enjoys good stationery, this place has something for everyone. I’ve bought notebooks and pens from here that lasted a long time and were really comfortable to use.

What truly sets this shop apart is the customer service. The staff are friendly, patient, and genuinely helpful. They’re always willing to give recommendations or help you find exactly what you’re looking for, without ever rushing you. You can tell they really care about their customers.

Overall, this is one of the best stationery shops I’ve been to. It’s perfect for school supplies, gifts, or treating yourself to something nice. I highly recommend it to anyone who loves stationery or wants quality products with great service. I’ll definitely keep coming back!
